content.short: Finom is a European business banking platform with accounts, e-invoicing, cards and expense management.
content.description: Finom, founded in 2019, is a European business banking platform built for freelancers, startups and small companies that want banking and finance admin in one place. From a single account it offers local German, French and Italian IBANs, prepaid business debit cards with cashback, integrated e-invoicing, expense management and accounting integrations, helping owners get paid, control spending and keep on top of bookkeeping. It operates across markets including Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the Netherlands, and is known for fast onboarding such as a German IBAN in 24 hours. Finom is backed by investors including Target Global and General Catalyst.
